What do you guys prefer? 1️⃣ empty array 2️⃣ null 3️⃣ error code -30404 🙈 we need the PR to the PR array or null is my preference which Marius has currently coded pls vote then https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/630/files#r2036956649 What if we introduce a new field in blobSchedule settings, like this: ``` "prague": { ... }, "osaka": { "target": 9, "max": 12, "baseFeeUpdateFraction": 5007716, "maxPerTx": 6, // or "maxGasPerTx": 786432 } ``` and start additionally declining txs above such new limit. Wdyt guys? By declining do you mean in the mempool or as a validity condition of blocks? Both is this a backdoor way to get one of those EIPs which wasn't CFI'd? I like it is there much reason to include this in a part which is meant to facilitate scaling? the putative urgency of BPOs is that they enable scaling, and people just can't wait `n` months. But it doesn't seem like a much an issue here either way I like the idea too 👍 It may help to postpone pressure on tx pool until it is scaled enough Or we can try to scale it and don't involve additional limits 😄 as we have time ig There's no such EIP at this point right? So no change to get it included unless there's an argument later that it's a security problem for the mempool? No such or similar one I know about, I can try it to craft quickly Is `engine_getBlobsV2` expected to be mandatory in Osaka? As compared to `engine_getBlobsV1` which is currently optional, but has a [PR for non-optional](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/628) Imo it should be mandatory, because it would be the way to do local block building at high blob counts In principle it would of course be ok if only a high percentage of the network supported it, because they would then also re-propagate it, but I don't see why wouldn't make it mandatory, it's just better if everyone supports it Adding an EIP And here is a draft https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9621 But if you guys think it's better to include it as a part of peerdas I'm all for that, less eips - less activation bugs. Or even a part of BPO forks [EIP](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7892) ? Updated the PR based on discussion, now return `null` if there's blob missing: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/630 Personally I'd include it as part of PeerDAS, but no strong opinion Because it sounds like peerdas requirement, OK, updating the existing eip Created a PR for this to see if there's interest in codifying it https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4262 Blob count per tx limits as an update of peerdas EIP: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9623
